description: High-volatility events. The straddle skips the SESSION THAT ABSORBS each event, which is not always the release date — see `impact`.

_impact.same_session: Released while NSE is open, so the release date itself is the reacting session. RBI MPC lands ~10:00 IST, mid-session.
_impact.next_session: Released after the 15:15 NSE close, so the reacting session is the next trading day. US CPI 08:30 ET = 18:00 IST; FOMC 14:00 ET = 23:30 IST. Rolls forward over weekends and `market_holidays`.
_impact._note: A missing or misspelled `impact` degrades to same_session (the pre-2026-08-13 behaviour) rather than silently relocating a skip.

_market_holidays_note: NSE trading holidays, needed only so a next_session roll can step over one. INTENTIONALLY EMPTY — these were not verified against the NSE circular, and a wrong date here would move a skip onto the wrong session. Weekends are handled in code. Populate from the official NSE holiday list before relying on a roll that lands adjacent to a holiday; until then the [EVENT] log line always prints the release date it resolved from, so a bad roll is visible.
